message.content:
Based on the two screenshots provided, here is what I see:

**(1) Section Visibility:**
*   **Experience:** **Yes.** This section is fully visible in the first screenshot (mid-page). It displays a list of four job roles with dates, titles, companies, and descriptions.
*   **Contact:** **Yes.** This section is visible at the top of the second screenshot (bottom of page). It contains the heading "Have a product that needs a clear, usable interface?", descriptive text, an email link ("hello@dymasalfin.com"), and a "Book a 30-min call" button.
*   **Services:** **No.** This section is not visible in either screenshot. It likely appears above the Experience section.
*   **Testimonials:** **No.** This section is not visible in either screenshots. It likely appears between the Experience and Contact sections.

**(2) Footer Presence:**
**Yes.** The footer is clearly visible at the very bottom of the second screenshot. It contains the name "Dymas Alfin", title "UI/UX Designer · Jakarta, ID", copyright text "© 2026 — All rights reserved", tech stack credit ("Built with Next.js, GSAP & Framer Motion"), and a "Back to top" button.

**(3) Layout Bugs or Content Cut-off:**
**Yes, there is a significant layout issue.**
In the second screenshot (the Contact section), there is massive text that reads "**hello?**" rendered in an extremely large font size. This giant text is overlapping and obscuring the content immediately behind it. Specifically:
*   It covers the row of social media links (partially hiding text like "@dymasalfin", "LinkedIn", etc.).
*   It creates a visual collision with the email link and button area above it.
*   While not strictly "cut off" (the letters are fully rendered), the element is poorly positioned or sized, causing it to obstruct other important UI elements.
